title: Descent for n-Stacks
author: André Hirschowitz, Carlos Simpson
note: The source is a single gzipped TeX file. The English abstract is the authors' own; the body is translated from the French. The translation follows the modernized source prepared in arxiv-fixes/math_9807049v3 (v3, 2001), which preserves the authors' v2/v3 errata. The build produces 183 pages against the original's 250; %@ pages always refers to the original PDF.
license: arXiv.org perpetual, non-exclusive licence (original); translation prepared for this repository.
warnings: Translation in progress; see the per-file %@ status comments in src/.
The authors' v3 errata (an error in Proposition 6.1/Lemma 6.2, with consequences for 10.11, 12.1, 14.4, 15.8, 19.4 and 21.1) is preserved in the translation but was not independently checked.
Section 4 as printed says 'if A is fibrant over X then p_*(A) is fibrant over X' although A lives over Z; left as printed (the first X is presumably Z).

Bibliographic titles are left in their original language; only the authors' annotations are translated. The repository's French-leftover detector therefore reports French function words inside the bibliography.
